feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no result is stated for it. The candidate changes two controller fields from the best raced design, iteration 6 (kp 6.5, kd 0.6, 16 mm sensors at x = ±0.030 m, base_speed 1.4, ki 0.05, last_direction, score 122.66). It sets kp to 6.0 and keeps kd at 0.6. Geometry, base_speed, ki and line_loss are unchanged. The rationale is consistent with the evidence, but its main hypothesis is weakly supported. Lowering kp has not reduced oscillation so far: oval steering_oscillation was 0.250 at kp 7.0 (iteration 5) and rose to 0.270 at kp 6.5 (iteration 6). Oval max_error also moved the wrong way for a fix, from 0.063 to 0.064. So a further kp cut is more likely to hold oscillation near 0.27 or raise it than to bring max_error under 0.06. Body width cannot relax the off-track limit, so control must hold max_error under 0.06. Iteration 7 (kd 0.5) scored lower at 91.44, which argues against reducing damping. The candidate is still a clean single-variable test against the best design, and four review-and-revision runs remain with three iterations after this one. So it is worth racing rather than revising on paper. After the race, use the telemetry as follows. If oval max_error is still at or above 0.06, stop cutting kp. Widen geometry.sensor_positions to x = ±0.040 m with 16 mm sensors, and test kp near 8.0 with kd 0.6. If oval steering_oscillation is still above 0.2 and kp 6.0 is not better than iteration 6, return to kp 6.5 and kd 0.6 as the base. If line_loss_events stay at 1 or more at the same bend entries, test line_loss search_left or search_right, choosing the side the failing bends turn towards. Raise base_speed toward 1.6 only if progress is still below 1 while max_error is under 0.06.
requested_changes: After the race: if oval max_error stays at or above 0.06, widen geometry.sensor_positions to x = ±0.040 m with 16 mm sensors and test controller.kp near 8.0 with kd 0.6, because the edge response has held max_error near 0.06 across iterations 3 to 6 and cutting kp did not reduce it.

After the race: if steering_oscillation stays above 0.2 and kp 6.0 is not better than iteration 6, return to kp 6.5 with kd 0.6 and do not cut kp further, because oscillation rose from 0.250 at kp 7.0 to 0.270 at kp 6.5.

After the race: if line_loss_events stay at 1 or more at the same bend entries (iteration 6: 1.3 oval, 1.6 s-bend), change controller.line_loss from last_direction to search_left or search_right, favouring the side the failing bends turn towards.
